jobs.occupation: Head of CoE Accounting (m/f/d) (Bilanzbuchhalter/in/Bachelor Professional in Bilanzbuchhaltung)
jobs.description:
For our Zeppelin Finance Organization at our location in Garching near Munich, we are currently looking for a "Head of CoE Accounting (m/f/d)".

Your tasks & responsibilities:

* In your role as “Head of CoE Accounting (m/f/d),” you will be responsible for ensuring that the Group’s financial statements are prepared properly, on time, and efficiently, as well as for the continuous development of accounting policies, standards and processes.
* You will report to our Director Accounting, Controlling, Risk, ICS & Insurance and ensure compliance with all relevant accounting standards and guarantee a professional financial reporting process for all Group companies worldwide.
* As a key role in the finance department, you will serve as a sparring partner for the Group Management Board, the Heads of Accounting, Controlling, Risk, ICS and Insurance, Group Controlling, Treasury, and Tax, as well as the auditors and finance managers of the Group companies.
* In addition, you will assume overall responsibility for the preparation of the consolidated financial statements and help ensure compliance with IFRS accounting standards throughout the Group.
* In this role, you will also assume leadership of the Center of Excellence Accounting Team and thereby ensure the development of an efficient and standardized accounting structure.
* Among other responsibilities, you will ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and internal Group requirements (including those related to the Group-wide chart of accounts) and serve as the point of contact for auditors and government agencies.
* Your responsibilities also include the harmonization and standardization of global accounting processes, the optimization of financial reporting processes, and the use of automation, digitalization, and AI solutions to improve efficiency.

What we are looking for:

* At least 5 years of professional experience in the accounting department of an international corporation or an auditing firm
* Several years of leadership experience in a comparable position
* Successfully completed degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a comparable qualification.
* Additional professional qualifications (e.g., CPA, Certified Auditor) are considered an advantage.
* In-depth knowledge of international financial reporting under IFRS
* Good knowledge of modern IT systems (such as SAP S/4HANA, Global Lease Center, Global Tax Center)
* Strong affinity for digitalization, automation, and data analysis
* Strong leadership and communication skills
* Very good knowledge of German and English, both written and spoken

What we offer:

* Unique corporate culture: Based on the values of Ferdinand Graf von Zeppelin, we act as a foundation company that is future-oriented, social, and sustainable.
* We are sustainable: We live and breathe environmental and climate protection. And we take this seriously: by 2030, we will make Zeppelin climate-neutral in its day-to-day business operations.
* Creative freedom: With us, you get the opportunity to drive issues forward on your own responsibility.
* Grow with Zeppelin: We support you with extensive development opportunities and a diverse training program.
* Z Colorful: We work with targeted activities, such as our women's network and our impulse series, to anchor diversity and its appreciation at Zeppelin.
* Work-life balance: We offer you mobile and flexible working and 30 days of vacation. In addition, we have various offers and initiatives around the topics of health, children and care.
* Health and fitness: Through our ZFIT initiative, you can participate in various theme weeks and yoga classes, or even lease a company bicycle.
* Company pension plan: We support your pension.

Please note that the exact title of this role may change in the following.

jobs.occupation: (Associate) Test Equipment Design Engineer, Tesla Engineering Germany (m/f/d) (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Test Engineering (Germany) team drives the development and delivery of world-class test solutions that accelerate product development and deepen engineering understanding across Tesla's vehicle programs. By leveraging Tesla's technology and engineering culture, the team builds efficient, flexible, and highly capable test infrastructure that directly influences the quality and pace of next-generation EV development. As a Test Equipment Engineer within the Germany division, you will be a critical contributor to test equipment design, build, and operation efforts spanning high voltage distribution, battery systems, structural and vibration validation, drive units, and drive inverters. This is a hands-on design role — you will own test solutions from concept through commissioning, working closely with validation engineers, technicians, and Tesla counterparts to ensure that the right equipment is in place to support program milestones.

What You’ll Do

- End-to-End Design: Lead the mechanical and electro-mechanical design (3D CAD, schematics, FEA) of test rigs, dynamometers, shaker fixtures, and HV distribution panels for battery, drive unit, and structural validation.
- Instrumentation & Integration: Specify and integrate sensors, actuators, and measurement equipment, collaborating with controls engineers to ensure seamless DAQ integration and CE/IEC/VDE safety compliance.
- Project Management: Own test equipment projects from concept through commissioning—managing vendors, scopes, and aggressive timelines while tracking deliverables via Jira/Confluence.
- Hands-On Commissioning: Drive the physical assembly, installation, and validation of test equipment on the shop floor, performing root-cause analysis on hardware issues.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with validation engineers, technicians, and global TSE teams to translate test objectives into robust, efficient equipment requirements and author comprehensive build documentation (BOMs, MIs).

What You’ll Bring

- Education & Experience: BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field, with 3+ years of hands-on experience designing electro-mechanical test systems or industrial machinery. EV powertrain or HV experience is strongly preferred.
- Mechanical Engineering Core: Proficiency in 3D CAD (CATIA V5 preferred), GD&T, structural/fatigue analysis (FEA), and diverse manufacturing processes (machining, weldments, sheet metal). Experience with rotating systems and rotor dynamics is a major plus.
- Test Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one of the following areas:
High Voltage / Battery: HV circuit design, safety interlocks, thermal conditioning, or pack-level fixtures.
Structural / Vibration: Shaker table fixtures, accelerometer instrumentation, and shock profiles (IEC/MIL-STD).
Drive Unit / Inverter: Dynamometer integration, torque measurement, and EOL test hardware.
- Electrical & DAQ: Solid understanding of high-voltage safety principles, measurement instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power analyzers), automotive protocols (CAN/LIN), and test automation frameworks (LabVIEW, Python).
- Soft Skills & Culture: Exceptional hands-on aptitude, strong project management skills, and the ability to self-direct in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Fluent English required; German language skills are a strong advantage.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.
